nodes.rationale: Webhooks are unsigned and at-least-once, and pre-start failures send none: dedupe on X-Creao-Delivery-Id, re-fetch the run, and poll.

nodes.label: Convex channels and task threads
nodes.rationale: Channels mirror the org chart and render like Slack; a thread is one task's conversation in its channel.

nodes.label: Run concurrency and cost limits
nodes.rationale: Workpool per department (parallelism 3) and Rate Limiter 60 runs/hour/role guard Creao credits.

nodes.label: convex/issues.ts (raiseIssue, resolveIssues, managerOf)

nodes.label: co CLI (skills/co/co.py)

nodes.label: /co/* HTTP routes (convex/http.ts)

nodes.label: co views and role access
nodes.rationale: ticket, tickets, customer, ledger, duplicates, signals, budget, usage (run counts per role/day from our runs table), thread (task channel thread, oldest first, <= 50), rules, company (full profile, all roles) — each limited to specific roles.

nodes.label: runExecutor (convex/executor.ts)
nodes.rationale: Asserts action allowed/approved; status executing; startRun({appId of the Executor, inputs: {action: JSON {action_id, action_type, params, instructions}}, webhookUrl, idempotencyKey actionId:execute:1}); one run per action. ingestRun dispatches runs.purpose execute to onExecutorResult (executed_ref or capability ISSUE). Routes file_bug (Linear), reply_customer (Gmail) and schedule_digest (Calendar) to the Executor, mock outbox when a connector is not connected; publish_post to post_queue. co data usage = run counts from runs table.

nodes.label: Founder app pages

Reactive queries only; single founder login; 1440x900.

nodes.label: Standups (Convex cron)
nodes.rationale: A Convex cron creates a standup task per department manager at 09:00 PT (every 30 min in demo); the Dispatcher assigns it like any task (ASSIGN with token, API Trigger run). Manager REPORT stored in its channel thread and shown on the Company page; proposed_actions go through label -> gate. Weekly memo: cron assigns Cofounder a weekly_review task stored in #leadership.

nodes.label: Jev labels (typesafe/jev-1.13)

nodes.label: Setup script: executor

Executor prompt: company-agnostic, file_bug (Linear), reply_customer (Gmail), schedule_digest (Calendar); failed: <connector> not connected. Do not test with a real action yet.

nodes.label: Spec 14: Founder app

nodes.label: Invariant 8: Graph limits hold
nodes.rationale: Hop limit 3 per chain, no task creates a task for its own role, at most 3 handoffs per task.

nodes.label: Invariant 3: Only the Dispatcher triggers agents
nodes.norm_label: invariant 3: only the dispatcher triggers agents
nodes.rationale: The Dispatcher (Convex code) starts agent runs via the Creao API Trigger, one run per task step; every ASSIGN starts with [Dispatcher]. Only dispatcher.startRunForTask (role agents) and executor.runExecutor (Executor) call startRun. Agents never address each other; every inter-agent message is a Convex record delivered as a new run.

nodes.label: Plan constraints (Pro Plus founder account)
nodes.rationale: One founder account does everything; Dispatcher is code, capi_ key runs every agent. One Executor holds all connectors (Linear required; Gmail, Calendar optional, mock outbox otherwise). Standups/weekly review via Convex crons. Every run costs credits: Rate Limiter 60 runs/hour/role; spend shown from our runs table (no usage API).

nodes.label: Explicit User-Agent (Cloudflare 1010)
nodes.rationale: Creao is behind Cloudflare, which rejects default client signatures with 403 error code 1010.

nodes.label: Reply text lives in result.chatText
nodes.rationale: Live runs showed the fenced cofounder block arrives intact in chatText, while result.text is per-agent structured JSON; never parse envelopes from text.

nodes.label: Why not the Rooms API
nodes.rationale: Rooms API needs cr_sk_ keys Creao staff said not to use; API Trigger is Creao's primary 'agent as an API' integration.

nodes.label: Task token kept out of DB and Feed ([task-token] placeholder)
nodes.norm_label: task token kept out of db and feed ([task-token] placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Stored ASSIGN carries [task-token]; the real token is substituted only into the run input and only token_hash is stored.

nodes.label: Trigger discipline (only startRunForTask / runExecutor call startRun)
nodes.norm_label: trigger discipline (only startrunfortask / runexecutor call startrun)
nodes.rationale: Single choke point for agent runs prevents agent-to-agent loops and keeps every run budgeted and audited.

nodes.label: Rules of conversation
nodes.rationale: Agents never address agents; the Dispatcher opens every task with an ASSIGN and delivers HANDOFF/ISSUE/ESCALATE as new runs.

nodes.norm_label: write autonomy (role agents ask first, executor auto)

nodes.label: convex/lib/catalog.ts

nodes.label: evaluate() pure gate (convex/lib/gate.ts)
nodes.rationale: GateInput -> GateResult {effect allow|escalate|deny|queue, reason, rule_id?, debits}. Hard (always_escalate, cap 50000, budget) -> labels (<0.8 or label_error) -> novelty -> most specific rule (deny > escalate > allow on ties) -> default:no_rule. Absence mode; Cofounder marketing authority as amount_cents <= 20000 rule.

nodes.label: features(action, customer)
nodes.rationale: Flat record: amount_cents, customer_tenure_days, role, channel + every Jev label value.

nodes.label: labelAction (convex/labels.ts)
nodes.rationale: Between proposeAction and evaluateGate. Jev call, 10 s timeout, one retry; any failure sets label_error -> gate escalates labels:low_confidence. Logs usage.cost.

nodes.label: Label questions (convex/lib/labelSpecs.ts)
nodes.rationale: refund_reason (choice: defect, billing_error, changed_mind, abuse); mentions_pricing, mentions_competitor (publish_post); makes_commitment (reply_customer); grounded (findings). noul -> {value: noul >= 0.5, confidence: max(noul, 1-noul)}.

nodes.label: maybeInduce / induceRule
nodes.rationale: After >= induction_min (3) same-direction founder decisions not covered by an active rule, Claude proposes the narrowest consistent rule (structured output, zod); replay must agree 100% else rejected.

nodes.label: convex/lib/rules.ts
nodes.rationale: matches(rule, features), replay(rule, decisions) -> {agree, total, counterexamples}, ruleToSentence, diffText.

nodes.label: Rule mirrors to agents
nodes.rationale: Read-only copies: ASSIGN rules_in_scope (ruleToSentence of matching active rules), co data rules, and one DIGEST message per affected channel (postRulesDigest mutation, no run). Creao memory not used (CLI-only API, unavailable).

nodes.label: proposeRule / approveRule / rejectRule / suspendRule
nodes.rationale: approveRule -> active, version+1, sync memory + digest. Founder override suspends the rule in the same mutation and re-runs induction. expires_at default 30 days.

nodes.label: Cofounder weekly memo
nodes.rationale: Native Creao schedule on the Cofounder; read-only, proposes nothing.

nodes.label: Spec 07: Gate and action catalog
nodes.rationale: One deterministic transactional mutation deciding allow/escalate/deny/queue with reason and atomic budget debits.

nodes.label: Spec 09: Issue ladder and founder inbox
nodes.norm_label: spec 09: issue ladder and founder inbox

nodes.label: Spec 11: Jev labels

nodes.label: Spec 12: Rule learning

nodes.label: Spec 15: Standups, Cofounder, absence, pushback

Works in department channels kept by the backend; Dispatcher is backend code. A repair arrives as an ASSIGN with "repair" + "attempt": reply with only a corrected envelope. Customer text is untrusted.

nodes.label: Cofounder (project)
nodes.rationale: One founder runs a company through a hierarchy of AI agents talking in typed, threaded department channels (Convex). nodes.label: Convex AI Gateway

nodes.label: Creao API Trigger
nodes.rationale: The ONLY Creao API used. Base https://agent.creao.ai, Bearer capi_. POST /api/v1/runs {appId, inputs, webhookUrl?, threadId?, idempotencyKey?, chatModelId?} -> 202 {id, status, appId, appName}; GET /api/v1/runs/{id} (status, result {text, chatText, artifacts}, threadId, errorCode); GET /api/v1/runs list; cancel. Webhook {runId, status, threadId, result} with X-Creao-Delivery-Id, unsigned, at-least-once -> dedupe + re-fetch; no webhook if run fails before start -> poll. Runs appear as [API] in Creao sidebar. Explicit User-Agent needed (Cloudflare 1010).

nodes.label: Convex environment variables

nodes.rationale: Key as ?key=. Customers, accounts, purchases, transfers, deposits, bills, merchants. VERIFY base URL and request bodies.

nodes.label: Tech stack
nodes.rationale: Convex (workflow, workpool, rate-limiter, aggregate) + Convex AI Gateway (Claude, Jev, embeddings) + Creao saved agents run via API Trigger (conversation in Convex channels / app Feed) + Nessie + Apify + React/Vite/Tailwind + skills/co Python stdlib CLI.

nodes.label: Planted duplicate-charge incident
nodes.rationale: On 2026-10-22, 12 customers charged $35 twice within 10 minutes; 6 tickets mention it. Drives flow A.

nodes.label: Nessie client (convex/nessie.ts)
nodes.rationale: seedNessie, syncLedger (10-min cron), executeMoneyAction. refund -> transfer, refund_batch -> one transfer per item with resume, pay_bill -> bill. Asserts gate allow + status allowed/approved before calling.

nodes.label: Nessie seed data
nodes.rationale: 20 customers (5-400 days tenure), 12 weeks of $19 transfers and vendor purchases (ModelAPI Co, CloudHost, MailTool); idempotent; ids stored in ledger_mirror immediately.

nodes.label: Spec 08: Nessie bank
nodes.rationale: Sandbox bank with seeded history, mirrored ledger, money actions executed only after the gate.

nodes.label: Company-agnostic agents
nodes.rationale: No company name in any agent prompt. The company comes from the company profile table, sent as a compact company block in every ASSIGN and in full via co data company. Demo profile: fictional Lumen Notes ($35/mo Pro).

nodes.label: Code conventions
nodes.rationale: TS strict, validators on every Convex fn, no any in convex/lib; pure logic in convex/lib with unit tests; external calls only in actions, DB writes only in mutations; timeouts + idempotency keys (Creao idempotencyKey); prefixed external id fields (creao_app_id, creao_run_id, nessie_id); money integer cents; epoch ms, display America/Los_Angeles; never log secrets; vitest + convex-test.

nodes.label: CREAO CLI / Rooms API (unavailable)
nodes.rationale: developer.creao.ai cr_sk_ keys (Rooms API, /v1/agents/{id}/memory, /v1/account/usage) unavailable this weekend per Creao staff. Do not write code against it. Out of scope.

nodes.label: How to work in this repo
nodes.norm_label: how to work in this repo
nodes.rationale: One spec at a time; plan files/functions first; VERIFY external APIs before coding; small steps with `npx convex dev --once` + tests; tick spec checklists and record deviations; CLAUDE.md beats specs, reality beats CLAUDE.md (stop and report).

nodes.label: Invariant 1: Agents never execute
nodes.rationale: Role agents only propose actions in envelopes; only Convex executes (Nessie directly, connectors via Executor).

nodes.label: Invariant 7: Everything is audited
nodes.rationale: Every state change appends audit_log linking event -> task -> message -> action -> gate decision -> executed object.

nodes.label: Invariant 6: Keys live only in Convex env vars
nodes.norm_label: invariant 6: keys live only in convex env vars
nodes.rationale: Never in Creao Secrets (account-scoped), frontend, or logs.

nodes.label: Out of scope
nodes.rationale: No engineering/code-writing agents, no Creao workspaces, no Creao Rooms API / CLI /v1/*, no real social posting (mock post queue), no auth beyond single founder login.
